hypotheses.C0_manual_native_matches_checkpoint: The unmodified branch reproduces checkpoint-native logits with maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.C1_probe_roles_have_causal_discriminatio: At least four of six frozen heads reach signed causal AUROC at least 0.60 on untouched FineWeb.
hypotheses.C2_selected_heads_beat_other_heads: At least four frozen heads exceed their layer's median control-head causal AUROC by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.C3_selected_heads_are_top_three_causal: At least four frozen heads rank among the top three of nine heads by untouched causal AUROC.
hypotheses.C4_attention_role_is_not_only_decodable: At least four frozen heads have positive versus negative standardized causal-effect separation of at least 0.30 in the calibration-selected direction.
hypotheses.C5_full_attention_contains_the_role: For at least four candidates, complete local-attention removal has signed causal AUROC at least 0.60.
